sloka: शिरसा चरणावेतौ वन्दमानमनिन्दिते ।पुनर्द्रक्ष्यसि कल्याणि! पुत्रं चन्द्रमिवोदितम् ॥२-४४-२२॥
transliteration: śirasā caraṇāvetau vandamānamanindite ।punardrakṣyasi kalyāṇi! putraṁ candramivoditam ॥2-44-22॥

translations.english: O irreproachable and auspicious one you will see your son, like the rising Moon, touching your feet with his head.
